webProjects.title: Antivirus Dashboard
webProjects.desc: Real-time threat monitoring with scan logs, agent management and live status reporting.
webProjects.readme:
About the Project

The Safeguard Antivirus Dashboard is a security-focused admin panel that aggregates threat intelligence from server agents. It displays critical vulnerabilities, CPU/RAM usage of server endpoints, and live file scan logs.

Key Features

  • Real-time Logs: Renders active scans dynamically as they occur on the endpoint systems.
  • Agent Status Mapping: Visual representation of all active and offline local network agents.
  • Action Center: Quarantine files or trigger immediate scans directly from the browser.

Tech Stack

Built with PHP for session handling and data management, Python for system-level scanner agents, MySQL for log persistence, and pure CSS for smooth transitions.

webProjects.title: Online Store Platform
webProjects.desc: Full-stack shop with product management, cart, checkout flow and admin control panel.
webProjects.readme:
About the Project

A full-featured e-commerce ecosystem built from scratch. It supports user profiles, responsive catalog browsing, persistent cart storage, check-out simulation, and a dedicated administrator interface.

Key Features

  • Inventory Control: Management panel to add, edit, and delete products, categories, and inventory.
  • Cart System: Dynamic local storage fallback cart that syncs when the user logs in.
  • Secure Checkout: Encrypted user authentication and simulated payment integration.

Tech Stack

Powered by raw PHP and MySQL, styled with modern Vanilla CSS including custom flex layouts and custom variables for the shopping interface.

webProjects.title: Analytics Dashboard
webProjects.desc: Interactive data visualisation with real-time charts, filters and CSV export.
webProjects.readme:
About the Project

A lightweight, interactive client-side dashboard that converts CSV exports and database queries into actionable visual charts.

Key Features

  • Dynamic Charts: Custom bar, line, and doughnut charts showing business telemetry.
  • Filtering Options: Segment records by custom dates, categories, and region.
  • Data Exports: Export parsed dashboards back into clean CSV/PDF files instantly.

Tech Stack

Developed using Chart.js, HTML5, Vanilla JavaScript, and backend API integration using PHP.

webProjects.title: Custom Blog CMS
webProjects.desc: Blog management with rich-text editing, categories, tags and basic SEO tooling.
webProjects.readme:
About the Project

An intuitive content management system built to ease technical writing. It features an integrated WYSIWYG editor and instant SEO health analysis.

Key Features

  • Rich Text Editing: Integration with TinyMCE for editing layout blocks, images, and formatting code.
  • Tag & Category Indexing: Dynamic organization and search indices optimized for search engines.
  • SEO Checklist: Analyzes keyword density, descriptions, and tag structures before publishing.

Tech Stack

Written using PHP and MySQL backend, combined with JS dynamic tags styling.

webProjects.title: PHP Security Toolkit
webProjects.desc: Reusable library covering SQL injection, XSS, CSRF protection and input sanitisation.
webProjects.readme:
About the Project

A reusable, plug-and-play middleware package for legacy PHP applications that mitigates the top OWASP security vulnerabilities.

Key Features

  • SQL Injection Shield: Automated parameter wrapping for standard queries.
  • XSS Filter: Strict sanitization of user-submitted forms and output encoders.
  • CSRF Token Generator: Automatic session validation tokens injected into HTML form tags.

Tech Stack

Coded in PHP, distributed as a Composer package for simple dependency installation.

softProjects.title: Python Scraper & Bot
softProjects.desc: Automated scraper and notification bot for data collection, scheduling and reporting.
softProjects.readme:
About the Project

A headless script designed to monitor target websites for specific updates, scrape critical elements, and send instant alerts to Discord or Telegram channels.

Key Features

  • Dynamic Scraping: Selenium drivers handle JavaScript-heavy websites and cloudflare bypasses.
  • Rate Limiting: Intelligent scheduling to prevent IP bans.
  • Instant Alerts: Webhook triggers immediately upon detecting target keywords or price drops.

Tech Stack

Coded in Python using BeautifulSoup, Selenium, and webhook APIs.

softProjects.title: Dev Toolbox CLI
softProjects.desc: Command-line utility for repetitive dev tasks — scaffolding, env setup and deployment helpers.
softProjects.readme:
About the Project

A lightweight command-line tool built to accelerate local environment bootstrap tasks, git branch cleaners, and static site compiler scripts.

Key Features

  • Quick Scaffolding: Create templates for HTML/CSS or PHP structures instantly.
  • Git Helper: Cleans up merged local branches and formats standardized commits.
  • Rich Output: Console formatting using coloring, progress bars, and custom logs.

Tech Stack

Built with Python, Click, and Rich libraries, packaged as a globally executable terminal command.

softProjects.title: Task Manager App
softProjects.desc: Simple cross-platform task manager with offline support, categories and due-date reminders.
softProjects.readme:
About the Project

A cross-platform task manager designed to prioritize focus. Offers offline sync with a robust local database and smart grouping.

Key Features

  • Offline Mode: Fully operational without network connection using local database caches.
  • Reminders: Local system push alerts mapped to custom priority tags.
  • Statistics: Weekly charts showing finished tasks and productivity peaks.

Tech Stack

Written in Flutter using Dart, with SQLite for local relational database storing.

softProjects.title: REST API Backend
softProjects.desc: Modular REST API with JWT auth, rate limiting, caching and full OpenAPI documentation.
softProjects.readme:
About the Project

A production-ready REST API backend designed with enterprise patterns, supporting standard database integrations and OpenAPI descriptors.

Key Features

  • JWT Authentication: Secure token-based access with sliding expiration and refresh tokens.
  • Rate Limiting: Middleware blocking spam and automated scraping bots.
  • Self-Documenting: Swagger UI panel generated automatically from controller annotations.

Tech Stack

Engineered using Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and JSON Web Tokens.
